cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your tea is approved for drinking, love. Exactly how you like it; some dates and details do stay in my head.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought your birthday cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Late arrivals are welcome, darling. You may have a warmed plate; I've kept the candle ready through all four weeks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Singing approved, love. Come close and I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

reason: Make each superior grant affectionate and materially caring while the late date and interrupted call remain barbs; remove the cold generic reprimand.
